description: Vidu Q4 Preview (viduq4-preview): next-gen flagship for expressive audio & video; image-to-video and reference-to-video, 1–16s, 540p/720p/1080p/2K/4K, 24fps. Today’s global pricing page lists only credit consumption (540p 9 / 720p 19 / 1080p 24 / 2K 38 / 4K 78 credits per second) and restates the RMB credit unit price (1 credit = RMB 0.03125); it does not publish a USD credit rate, so a verifiable USD unit price cannot be derived for this region. Kept catalog_only + hidden without a pricing file pending an official USD quote.
